biography: Antoine Gosse, born in the shadow of the Circuit Paul Ricard, practically inhaled gasoline fumes from infancy. His father, a former mechanic for Ligier, instilled a love for motorsport early on, teaching Antoine to rebuild a carburetor before he could ride a bike. He started karting at age eight, dominating the local scene with a ferocity that earned him both trophies and black flags. His breakthrough came at the Volant Winfield competition, where his raw speed and audacious overtaking maneuvers caught the eye of Milano GT36 team principal, Isabella Rossi. Rossi took a gamble on the fiery young Frenchman, and Gosse hasn't disappointed. He's now a mainstay in the GT36 series, consistently challenging for podiums and establishing himself as a force to be reckoned with. Despite near misses, the championship title still eludes him, fueling his relentless pursuit of victory.
drivingStyle: Gosse's driving style is best described as controlled aggression. He's known for late braking and daring overtakes, often threading the needle where others wouldn't dare. While some criticize his tendency to overdrive the car, particularly in the early stages of a race, his raw speed and ability to extract maximum performance from his machine are undeniable. He manages tire wear adequately, though his aggressive corner entries sometimes lead to increased degradation towards the end of a stint. Under pressure, Gosse thrives, often finding an extra gear when his rivals falter.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Monza that cost Gosse a potential race win. Bellini's defensive driving style often clashes with Gosse's aggressive overtaking attempts.

Petrova, known for her clinical precision, represents the antithesis of Gosse's flamboyant style. Their contrasting approaches often lead to intense battles on track, with each trying to prove the superiority of their technique.

Tanaka and Gosse frequently battle for position at the front of the field. Their rivalry is based on respect for each other's abilities, however both always push each other to the absolute limit with close racing and tactical maneuvering.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue socks for every race, regardless of weather conditions.
Before each race, he listens to a specific Édith Piaf song to calm his nerves.
He insists on personally polishing his helmet visor before every session, believing it improves his visibility.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. If you're not willing to risk everything for the win, you don't belong on the track.
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in 2021, after a nail-biting final stint where he held off intense pressure from Bellini, securing his first major endurance victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2022 GT36 championship finale at Interlagos, handing the title to Petrova and leaving him devastated.
